headline: United winless in seven but still favourites at Old Trafford
summary: Manchester United have now gone seven games without a win, and Tuesday's 1-4 defeat at Como in the Champions League left BBC Sport reporting that Michael Carrick's job is in jeopardy. Bournemouth arrive at Old Trafford on Sunday having won just one league game this season, but they are the side creating chances: 2.36 expected goals a game. Even so, the market makes United 50.8% favourites, with Bournemouth at 24.2%. The goals line sits at three, with over priced at 48.1%.
read: United are 13th with seven points from seven league games and come off a 4-1 Champions League defeat, yet they are still 50.8% favourites at Old Trafford against a Bournemouth side that has won only once in the league but created 4.4 xG in beating Sunderland. The market sees a tight home win with goals: a half-goal handicap and a three-goal line, with both teams to score at 61.1%.

facts.fact: Manchester United lost 4-1 at Como in the Champions League in midweek.
facts.meaning: They come into Sunday's home game with the manager's position under open scrutiny.

facts.fact: United have gone seven games without a win.
facts.meaning: They meet Bournemouth still chasing a first victory in a run that now stretches across the Champions League and the league.

facts.fact: United are rated 50.8% to win at Old Trafford.
facts.meaning: A clear favourite, but more a nod to home advantage than to form — Bournemouth are at 24.2%, roughly half United's chance.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap fair line has United about half a goal better at -0.55.
facts.meaning: The market sees a close game, not a home rout — United are narrowly the stronger side on a neutral reading.

facts.fact: Bournemouth have averaged 2.36 xG across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: The away side is the one creating chances — more than double United's 1.08 per game in the same span.

facts.fact: Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0 on 18 October with 4.4 xG to 0.13.
facts.meaning: They arrive off their biggest chance-creating display of this five-match run and out of the relegation zone.

facts.fact: The main goals line is 3.0, with Over priced at 48.1%.
facts.meaning: The market leans just under three goals — a high line for a match with only a half-goal favourite.

facts.fact: Both teams to score is priced at 61.1%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that both sides find the net on Sunday.

sources.fact: BBC Sport reports Michael Carrick's job is in jeopardy after Manchester United's 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como, described as one of the worst European nights in their history.
Carrick said after the Como defeat: "I'll take responsibility for the overall team and performance, it stops with me and I'm fine with that."
BBC Sport reports Manchester United first need to decide who will be in charge for Sunday's game against Bournemouth.
ESPN reports United have now gone seven games without a win ahead of Bournemouth's visit.
Bleacher Report reports United have two wins in 11 matches across all competitions this season after losing 4-1 to Como.
Goal reports Bournemouth teenager Eli Junior Kroupi has returned to first-team training and could make his first appearance of the season against Manchester United on Sunday.
BBC Sport notes Bournemouth won their last game but have only won one game this season.
Sports Mole reports that a two-week timeframe means Scott is expected to miss games including the trip to Manchester United.
